preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner/admin of the MasterChef contract
MasterChef contract must hold lpToken balances that can be stolen

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, first deploy a malicious migrator contract that implements the required interface. Then call setMigrator() to set the migrator address to your malicious contract. Finally, call migrate() with the target lpToken pool ID, which will trigger the malicious migrator to transfer all lpTokens from the MasterChef contract to the attacker's address using transferFrom().
